svg.title: Provider-agnostic personal OS architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture: mobile approval at top, owned control plane, owned memory and scheduler, model router, and swappable AI providers at the bottom. Everything above the router is owned by the user.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the mobile approval layer')
g.text: Approve, reject, or redirect tasks — from anywhere

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the control plane')
g.text: Orchestration, routing logic, task decomposition, webhooks

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me about the memory store design')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the scheduler design')
sendPrompt('Tell me about the model router and LiteLLM')
g.text: LiteLLM or equivalent — one interface, any provider

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I swap in Claude via LiteLLM?')
sendPrompt('How do I swap in OpenAI via LiteLLM?')
sendPrompt('How do I swap in Gemini via LiteLLM?')
sendPrompt('How does local workstation execution work?')
sendPrompt('How does Claude Code fit as an execution target?')
